provenance.note: an empty value from a bool flag's source is written through f.Set with the error discarded, so a validator that rejects the value never fails the flag; the later fix propagates that error instead

bugs.note: the else branch of the reviewed empty-value handling calls f.Set(f.Name, "false") as `_ = f.Set(...)`, discarding both the parse error and the validator error; the fix rewrites the branch to set val = "false" and return the error
